Definition: adverb from a derivative of the base of G2237; with pleasure:--gladly.
BiblicalUsage: When Paul reached Jerusalem the brothers received him gladly, and the word carries the warmth of that welcome. It is a small word for a large kindness.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a glad welcome is itself a ministry, and the Jerusalem believers gave Paul one when he needed it most.
